alt_texts: Wild greater one-horned rhino seen from behind on a floodplain near Chitwan, Nepal, head turned to the right, headline 'One park went from 12 rhinos to 2,613'
Greater one-horned rhino in tall dry grass in Kaziranga National Park, Assam, with text saying Kaziranga had 12 rhinos around 1900
Wild greater one-horned rhino standing side-on by a river in Chitwan, Nepal, with text on its former range across northern India
Greater one-horned rhino with a calf behind it in Kaziranga grassland, with text on how protection helped numbers recover
Wild greater one-horned rhino on a riverbank in Chitwan, Nepal, with the statistic 4,075 rhinos by March 2025
Wild greater one-horned rhino showing its folded armour-like skin, with text on its Vulnerable IUCN status
Close-up of a wild greater one-horned rhino's head and single horn, closing slide with sources and photo credits
